 Harris County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0017
 Randall Duncan, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
1-10-25
Counsel for defendant:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant answers Plaintiff's Original Petition by generally denying each and every allegation contained therein, and
demands strict proof thereof as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure. Pursuant to Rule 92, Defendant
denies that Plaintiff is entitled to recover any of the damages sought.
For further answer, and without assuming any burden of proof that the law places upon Plaintiff, Defendant asserts
the following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's own negligence proximately caused or contributed to the collision at issue. Plaintiff entered the
intersection against a traffic-control device or falied to yield the right of way, and under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil
Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must be reduced by Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility, and barred
entirely if that percentage exceeds fifty percent.
Second, the collision and any claimed injuries were caused in whole or in part by the acts or omissions of persons or
entities other than Defendant, for whom Defendant is not legally responsible. Defendant requests submisison of each
such responsible third party's percentage of responsibility.
Third, Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by not following reasonable medical advice and by incurring treatment
charges that exceed the amounts reasonably necessary to treat the claimed injuries. Any recovery must be limited
accordingly.
</page>

  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
